## What you will do

Open this file and click **Run Document**. Packages: `learnr`, `fpp3`.
Exercise chunks run when you click Run Code. They are not knitted in one pass.

## SES vs Holt
```{r holt-ex, exercise=TRUE, exercise.lines=14}
library(fpp3)
spain <- global_economy |> filter(Country == "Spain")
fit <- spain |>
  model(
    ses = ETS(log(GDP) ~ error("A") + trend("N") + season("N")),
    holt = ETS(log(GDP) ~ error("A") + trend("A") + season("N"))
  )
fit |> forecast(h = 8) |> autoplot(spain)
glance(fit) |> select(.model, AICc, AIC, BIC)
fit |> gg_tsresiduals()
```

```{r q1}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q1"]],
  answer("A trend (slope) component", correct = TRUE),
  answer("Only seasonal indices"),
  answer("An MA(1) error term only"),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

```{r q2}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q2"]],
  answer("False — AICc is not universal across families; use hold-out too", correct = TRUE),
  answer("True — lower AICc always wins every test set"),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

```{r q3}
question_text(
  lab_prompts[["q3"]],
  open_answer(),
  placeholder = "Prefer Holt/SES because …",
  trim = TRUE
)
```
